difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma collecting nine equivalent conditions for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S to be locally of finite type (source lines 4614-4653): the intrinsic condition, the pointwise condition, base change to arbitrary and to affine schemes, existence of an etale cover of the base or of the source, the conditions on commutative diagrams of schemes over X and Y, and a Zariski local condition on Y. The proof is a two-step reduction: conditions (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7) and (9) are each shown to imply the diagram condition (8) by building a suitable cover and invoking permanence under composition, conditions (1), (7) and (8) are equivalent by definition, and (1) is then shown to imply all the remaining ones by base change stability and by taking U = X.
